Inherited retinal dysfunction; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis despite neurological ancestry.

Cutaneous melanoma arising within a congenital melanocytic nevus.
Asymmetric short stature supports a skeletal growth disorder; no definition or phenotypes establish additional organs.
Structural anomaly of molar teeth; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.

Malignant lymphocytes primarily occupy marrow and peripheral blood; lymphoid lineage alone does not establish lymphoma or immune-mediated disease.

Carcinoma arising from the glandular epithelium of the stomach; metastatic sites are not intrinsic defining organs.

Isolated dilated cardiomyopathy with ventricular dysfunction; respiratory distress reflects heart failure rather than independent pulmonary damage.
Adenoma arising in the vagina, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Disorder of trimethylamine metabolism; odor in sweat, urine and breath does not indicate skin, kidney or airway damage.

Arthrogryposis/craniosynostosis, cleft palate and intellectual disability define syndrome; hydronephrosis and vesicoureteral reflux reported in 1/2 patients.
Riboflavin-responsive mitochondrial metabolic myopathy; ragged-red muscle fibers demonstrate muscle pathology underlying exercise intolerance.
Umbrella disorder of protein glycosylation; listed subtypes affect different organs, without evidence of another axis common across the group.
Skeletal dysplasia with vertebral abnormalities and enchondromas; pretibial blistering and skin erosion annotated at 80-99%. Neurological findings are only 5-29%.
